items.source: CONTINUE_ON_ERROR is the logical opposite of FAIL_ON_ERROR and a superset of IGNORE_FAILED_DROPS.
items.translation: CONTINUE_ON_ERROR 是 FAIL_ON_ERROR 的逻辑 相反，并且是 IGNORE_FAILED_DROPS 的 超集。

items.translation: default 的含义取决于声明@SqlConfig的上下文：

items.source: This is useful for a non-embedded database whose SQL dialect does not support an IF EXISTS clause in a DROP statement.
items.translation: 这对于不支持在 `DROP` 语句中包含 `IF EXISTS` 子句的非嵌入式数据库非常有用。

items.source:
This is effectively the default error mode so that if a script
is accidentally executed, it will fail fast if any SQL statement in
the script results in an error.
items.translation: 这实际上是默认的错误模式，因此如果脚本被意外执行，只要脚本中的任何 SQL 语句导致错误，就会快速失败。

items.source: If @SqlConfig is declared only locally, the default error mode is FAIL_ON_ERROR.
items.translation: 如果仅局部声明了 `@SqlConfig`，默认错误模式为FAIL_ON_ERROR。

items.source: If @SqlConfig is declared globally, the default error mode is FAIL_ON_ERROR.
items.translation: 如果全局声明了 `@SqlConfig`，默认错误模式为FAIL_ON_ERROR。

items.source: If @SqlConfig is declared globally and locally, the default error mode for the local declaration is inherited from the global declaration.
items.translation: 如果 `@SqlConfig` 同时在全局和局部声明，则局部声明的默认错误模式将从全局声明中继承。

items.source: Enumeration of modes that dictate how errors are handled while executing SQL statements.
items.translation: 枚举模式，这些模式规定了在执行 SQL 语句时如何处理错误。

items.source: Indicates that the default error mode should be used.
items.translation: 指示使用默认错误模式。

items.source: Indicates that failed SQL DROP statements can be ignored.
items.translation: 指示可以忽略失败的 SQL `DROP` 语句。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）

items.source:
Indicates that all errors in SQL scripts should be logged but not
propagated as exceptions.
items.translation: 指示记录 SQL 脚本中的所有错误，但不将其作为异常传播。

items.source: Indicates that script execution will fail if an error is encountered.
items.translation: 指示如果在执行脚本时遇到错误，则脚本执行将失败。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
